title: Federal Reserve holds rates steady amid inflation concerns
snippet: The Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged as officials cited persistent inflation pressures and a cautious outlook for the U.S. economy.

title: U.S. unemployment rate edges lower in latest jobs report
snippet: The Labor Department reported the unemployment rate fell slightly as employers added jobs in healthcare and technology sectors.

title: European leaders discuss security pact at summit
snippet: European Union leaders met to discuss a new security framework and continued support for regional defense coordination.

title: Major AI labs announce updated safety guidelines
snippet: Leading artificial intelligence companies published revised safety guidelines emphasizing transparency and third-party evaluation of models.

title: Stock markets rally after earnings beat expectations
snippet: U.S. stock indexes rose after several large companies reported quarterly earnings that exceeded analyst expectations.

title: Congress debates new infrastructure spending package
snippet: Lawmakers in Washington are debating a bipartisan infrastructure package focused on roads, bridges, and broadband expansion.

title: Climate scientists warn of record temperatures globally
snippet: Researchers reported global average temperatures reached new highs, with scientists urging accelerated emissions reductions.

title: Analysts dispute jobs report interpretation
snippet: Some economists argue the latest jobs figures overstate labor market strength and mask ongoing hiring slowdowns in manufacturing.
